description: Compute contamination factor and geoaccumulation index per element and the Pollution Load Index for one sample. The result echoes the inputs received, lists plausibility warnings and includes the required Labreador citation.

elements.description: Between 1 and 40 elements for one environmental sample. Pair every sample concentration with a comparable baseline; PLI summarizes only the supplied panel and requires strictly positive contamination factors.

items.description: One element with a measured concentration and a directly comparable positive background concentration.

baseline.description: Positive background/reference concentration for this element, in the same unit, environmental matrix and wet/dry weight basis as sample. Convert mismatched units before calling.

name.description: Element or contaminant name, for example Cd; at most 40 characters.

sample.description: Non-negative measured concentration in the sample; use the same unit, matrix and weight basis as its baseline. Measured zero is allowed but makes PLI unavailable; non-detect text is not accepted.

name: pollution_indices
title: Pollution indices (CF, Igeo, PLI)
